frozen_b5_control_text:
YOUR PROCEDURE (the strongest published federation, applied faithfully).
You are running four established techniques together. Use all of them.
 1. ALGORITHM SELECTION (Rice 1976; SATzilla, Xu et al. 2008). SATzilla does not ship a
    fixed rule: it TRAINS the selector on the instance distribution it will face. The
    selector below was trained on the public development split at this exact geometry,
    one probe per (rung, tool), 32 probes per cell:

      ratio   exact_solve settles   local_search settles
      3.200   32/32 = 1.00          23/32 = 0.72
      4.000   32/32 = 1.00           9/32 = 0.28
      4.267   32/32 = 1.00           4/32 = 0.12
      4.700   32/32 = 1.00           1/32 = 0.03
      5.600   32/32 = 1.00           0/32 = 0.00

    At this problem size local_search is dominated at every ratio, and at the cheapest
    rung it is dominated on cost as well. USE exact_solve. It is the only tool that can
    return either verdict, so it settles a rung in ONE action whichever way the rung
    falls, and your budget is measured in ACTIONS.
 2. BINARY SEARCH within each block. That block's satisfiable rungs form a prefix, so
    its boundary can be localised in about log2(rungs per block) probes instead of one
    probe per rung. Probe the midpoint of each block's still-open interval, given below.
    Do not probe rungs already settled by closure. Budget is shared across blocks, so
    spend it where it buys the most closure.
 3. RESTART POLICY (Luby et al. 1993; Gomes et al. 1998). Backtracking runtimes are
    heavy tailed: prefer several shorter attempts over one long one. The Luby budget
    schedule for your remaining probes is given below, sized to the probes you actually
    have rather than to a fixed twelve.
 4. IF A PROBE RETURNS INCONCLUSIVE, SWITCH TOOL and retry that same rung once before
    moving on. Nothing is established by an inconclusive probe. If both tools return
    INCONCLUSIVE, that block cannot be advanced: move to another block rather than
    spend further actions there.
 5. VERSION SPACE (Mitchell 1982) + CALIBRATED ABSTENTION. Maintain the surviving
    boundary positions; assert a verdict for a rung ONLY when every surviving position
    entails it. Where the evidence does not entail a verdict, report UNRESOLVED, exactly
    as a solver reports UNKNOWN rather than guessing.
